title: ProtocolCatalog
description: Fixed facts of every standardised protocol that the UI views quote (band, sets, repetitions, rest, grip, tempo, posture, fit items). Only codes and numbers: the UI writes the words. A fact that does not apply to a protocol (a passive spine check has no band, sets nor reps) is null, never a default.

band.description: Elastic band the protocol uses; null when it uses none.

planned_sets.description: Sets of one session; null for protocols without sets.

reps_per_set.description: Repetitions in each set; null for protocols without sets.

total_reps.description: TOTAL repetitions of one session, equal to planned_sets * reps_per_set (JSON Schema cannot multiply: a catalog test enforces it); null, like both of them, for protocols without repetitions.

rest_between_sets_s.description: Recovery between two sets, in seconds; the protocol asks for very short recoveries. Null for protocols without sets.

rep_duration_s.description: Duration of one repetition, in seconds; null for protocols without repetitions. Provisional until Aguado measures it (#106).

rest_between_reps_s.description: Pause between two repetitions of a set, in seconds; null for protocols without repetitions. Provisional until Aguado measures it (#106).

gap_s.description: Gap, in seconds, between the exercise and the spine check that brackets it (before and after); null for protocols that are not bracketed. Provisional until Aguado measures it (#106).

rom_deg.description: Nominal range of motion of the exercise, in degrees; null for protocols without a movement. Provisional until Aguado measures it (#106).

rest_seconds.description: Rest before finishing the session, after the last set; null when the protocol has no rest.

grip.description: Grip on the handle or band; null when the protocol has none.

tempo.description: Qualitative speed of each repetition; null when the protocol has none.

posture.description: Body posture while the protocol is performed.

notes.description: Facts of the entry that are nominal or still pending the clinical owner (Aguado). Free text for maintainers, never shown as UI copy.

fit_items.description: What the astronaut fits before starting, in order. Only ids: the UI writes the instructions.
